tables.description: Monthly count of water-tanker bookings and deliveries per HMWSSB section, stitched from the monthly CSVs HMWSSB publishes on Open Data Telangana. Dec 2022 is missing (empty file on the portal). Divisions were renumbered from Mar 2026; build a crosswalk before comparing sections across the change.

tables.description: HMWSSB's daily 'Statement of water levels in reservoirs' for every day since 1 Jan 2014: Osman Sagar, Himayat Sagar, Singur, Manjira, Akkampally (Krishna), Nagarjuna Sagar, Srisailam and, from 7 Dec 2014, Sripada Yellampally (Godavari), plus the report's Total(1 to 5) row. Values are as printed on the page. Known quirks: 16 dates between Oct 2019 and Jul 2020 list every reservoir twice (sl_no 1–8 and 9–16, different figures; use sl_no <= 8 for one row per day); the outside reservoirs are absent 18 Feb–27 Apr 2020 and 17 Oct–30 Dec 2022.
tables.source_name: HMWSSB, Statement of water levels in reservoirs

tables.licence: Public report of a Government of Telangana board; terms not stated on the page. Published for research and teaching.
